title: E0126: Path traversal via file_get_contents
plain_english: Reading files with `file_get_contents()` (or similar functions) using a path built from user input can allow path traversal if `../` sequences or other unsafe path components are not properly restricted.
why_matters: Path traversal vulnerabilities can: - Expose sensitive files such as `/etc/passwd`, source code, credentials, or configuration files - Reveal environment details and application secrets - Help attackers gather information for further attacks
what_it_checks: `file_get_contents()`, `file()`, `readfile()`, `fopen()` with paths built from tainted input
User-controlled paths that may include `../` or null byte (`%00`) sequences
